task_description.overview: Convert geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) to UTM coordinates and back using the utm package, enabling convenient handling of dense seismic station arrays.
steps: Provide a geographic latitude and longitude pair.
Call utm.from_latlon to obtain easting, northing, UTM zone number, and zone letter.
If needed, call utm.to_latlon with easting, northing, zone number, and zone letter to recover latitude and longitude.
Return the forward and reverse conversion results for verification.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using the 'utm' Python package, convert the geographic coordinate ({latitude}, {longitude}) to UTM coordinates. Save the conversion results to {result_data.save_name} with content {result_data.content}.
